candidates.name: JCAA - 'Benefit Maximizing Routes' (Shim, Ko, Park 2022)
candidates.status: checked - article open, underlying route vectors NOT published
candidates.finding: Article is CC BY 4.0. It USES vector data for eight Joseon Main Roads but does not publish it; no Data Accessibility Statement and no supplementary GIS files on the article page. Named sources: Yeojidoseo, Daedongjiji, Kim (2004), and the Academy of Korean Studies 2014-2017 reconstruction project.

candidates.name: npj Heritage Science - Sino-Korean Tribute Routes (Gong, Greenop, Keys, Landorf, 13 May 2025)
candidates.status: checked - no geometry published, reconstructed segment is in China
candidates.finding: Body read after Nature's idp cookie redirect chain. Data availability lists only base maps and environmental inputs (ALOS DEM, China Land Cover, ERA5-Land, OSM). No shapefile/GeoJSON/KML of the route. The reconstructed ~210 km segment is the Liaodong Eight Courier Stations section in Liaoning, China; the Korean-peninsula portion is not reconstructed. Limitations are explicitly stated.

candidates.name: Korea Heritage Service spatial data (data.go.kr 15089320 + 15148507, gis-heritage.go.kr)
candidates.status: checked - open licence confirmed, but wrong geometry semantics
candidates.finding: Both datasets: 제공기관 국가유산청, 확장자 SHP, 이용허락범위 '제한 없음', download via gis-heritage.go.kr (UTM-K, KOGL/공공누리 marking on the download page). Content is heritage DESIGNATED-AREA polygons (국보/보물/사적/명승/천연기념물...), not route centrelines; no period or reconstruction-limit statement. Related to 옛길 only through a handful of 명승 designations (문경새재, 대관령 옛길 등). Actual geometry type / CRS / item list not verifiable without opening the file.

candidates.name: Open research-repository sweep (Zenodo API, OSF, figshare)
candidates.finding: Zenodo returned 17 records, none a Korean historical road/route geospatial dataset (hits were Turkey, Russia, a Tokyo point cloud, and false positives on the surname 'Korea'). OSF/figshare search found no deposit for the Joseon road-network vectors either. Genuine absence, not a block.

candidates.name: David Rumsey Historical Map Collection (georeferenced IIIF maps)
candidates.status: partially checked - licence verified, catalogue inaccessible
candidates.finding: Copyright page read directly: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, attribution 'David Rumsey Map Collection, David Rumsey Map Center, Stanford Libraries', commercial use requires permission (carto@davidrumsey.com). BUT the LUNA catalogue browse for Korea returned a 'Verify Access' bot-verification screen and davidrumsey.georeferencer.com returned HTTP 403, so NO specific georeferenced Korea sheet could be confirmed. Not bypassed.

candidates.name: Open georeferencing platforms (Wikimaps Warper, MapWarper.net)
candidates.finding: Wikimaps Warper: only 5 warped maps match 'korea', all Admiralty nautical charts (1855-1962: Sinpo, Ulsan Man, Korea Strait, Japan and part of Korea). Coastal hydrography only, no inland roads or 역로. MapWarper.net returned an hCaptcha challenge instead of results; not bypassed.

conclusion: No publicly redistributable LineString dataset of Korean historical postal roads / old roads was found, and no confirmed redistributable georeferenced historical map of the Korean peninsula showing routes. The only known vector reconstruction of Joseon main roads is unpublished third-party data from the AKS 2014-2017 project; its distribution terms could not be verified with the available tools (waks.aks.ac.kr is HTTP-only and refused HTTPS; 국편 HGIS and Hisgeo are policy-restricted).
